\caption{\bt{One shared definition, store revenue, in \system\ (values recorded on one million sales rows). Publish (1--2): the verified answer of the learning agent becomes revision~0, with conditions derived from its structure. Optimize (3): an equivalent key-range rewrite is 20\% faster and becomes revision~1, which adds date-key contiguity as a maintained condition. Use (4): every later user agent that asks about the metric, knowing only its name, runs the valid revision on its snapshot instead of exploring. Maintain (5--7): a restatement corrects September's sales and keeps the old rows as non-current, which raises the version of \code{store\_sales} and breaks key uniqueness, so revision~1 is invalid; the one filter that restores the grain and reproduces the learning answer as of learning time becomes revision~2 and returns the restated September value. Used as written, revision~1 would return 14,300,525.64.}{\system\ 中的一个共享定义：门店营业额（数值记录自 100 万行销售数据）。发布（1--2）：学习智能体核对正确的答案成为版本 0，条件由其结构推出。优化（3）：等价的日期键范围改写快 20\%，成为版本 1，并新增日期键连续这一受维护的条件。使用（4）：之后每个问到该指标、只知道指标名的用户端智能体，都在自己的快照上执行有效版本，而不必探索。维护（5--7）：一次更正修改了 9 月的销售并把旧行保留为非当前行，使 \code{store\_sales} 的版本升高并破坏键唯一性，版本 1 失效；唯一能恢复粒度、并按学习时刻复现学习答案的过滤成为版本 2，返回更正后的 9 月值。若照原样执行版本 1，9 月将返回 14,300,525.64。}}
\label{fig:example}
\Description{Eight boxes in two rows. Top row: (1) Learn: the learning agent, an LLM agent, answers March store revenue with SUM(ss_net_paid), 13,570,368.70, verified correct; (2) Publish revision 0 after the publication checks, with key uniqueness, date join, join completeness, and the learning record; (3) Optimize: revision 1 expresses the period as a date-key range, equal on 14 periods, 29.1 to 23.3 ms, adding date-key contiguity; (4) User agents use it: a lookup returns revision 1, the declared query runs on one snapshot, 13,069,651.80, correct. An arrow labelled "a later write" leads to the bottom row: (5) Restatement: store_sales version v13 to v14, key uniqueness fails, revision 1 invalid, September as written 14,300,525.64; (6) Automatic repair: ss_is_current='1' passes, ss_is_current='0' fails, exactly one filter restores the grain; (7) Publish revision 2 after a regression test as of learning time: March with the learning SQL and the repaired SQL both 13,570,368.70, September 12,932,888.04. A red dashed box, reached when none or several filters work, shows the other outcome: no unique repair, e.g. after a duplicate load, the definition is invalidated and relearned.}
\end{figure*}
